title: Free Tools for Your Business
excerpt: Optimize your business without spending a cent. Tools that already exist and are free or very affordable.
author: Tu Emprendimiento
content:
You don't need to spend fortunes on software to manage your business. There are free or very affordable tools that do the job. Here's our selection of the most useful.

**Canva (canva.com)**
For graphic design without being a designer. Templates for Instagram, presentations, simple logos, flyers. The free version has almost everything you need. Ideal for creating visual content without hiring a designer.

**Google Drive**
Free cloud storage (15 GB). Documents, spreadsheets, presentations — all collaborative. Better than sending files back and forth on WhatsApp.

**WhatsApp Business**
Already mentioned, but worth repeating. Catalog, automated responses, labels, message statistics. Free. If you're not using it, you're leaving money on the table.

**Trello or Notion**
For organizing projects and tasks. The free version is enough for an individual entrepreneur or small team. Essential for not forgetting anything.

**Google My Business**
For appearing in local searches. Free. Register and fill out all possible fields — especially photos and updated hours.
